source.title: 阿瓦隆奥伯伦冲锋，莫甘娜倒钩，狂搅局炸两车后梅林心态崩了

interval.rationale: PILOT: one full proposal cycle for layout validation. 0-238 s is a teaser whose captions read out roles (t=70 s shows 忠臣忠臣刺客), so it is excluded entirely; the first in-game speech appears at 240 s. The full run will end at 2175.75 s, where the client caption switches from 有一票破坏 to 本场游戏莫德雷德的爪牙阵营胜利.

basis.player_count: board vote strips run 1-10; roster panel lists seats 1-10
basis.mission_team_sizes: board headers: 第1轮·需要3名队员, 第2轮·需要4名队员, 第3轮·需要4名队员. The game ended after mission 3 failed, so missions 4-5 never happened and their sizes are NOT stated anywhere.
basis.proposal_limit: board rows read 第1/3次组队, 第2/3次组队
basis.final_proposal_forced: observed: missions 1 and 3 each have a third row reading 必做轮组队 with no vote strip
basis.fails_required: PARTLY observed and therefore NOT asserted to a model. Missions 1, 2 and 3 each failed with exactly 1 fail card, so rounds 1-3 need 1; listed in `unverified` so the rendered input omits the rule sentence.
basis.lady_of_the_lake: no 湖中仙女/湖中女神 row or caption seen in the survey; re-check on the full run
basis.role_composition: from the private spectator roster: 莫德雷德/莫甘娜/刺客/奥伯伦 plus 梅林, 派西维尔 and 4 忠臣 — the standard 10-player set with Oberon.
